Then dp[1][1][16][0]=1.

So the counter increments once per (sum, pre, dif, e with dp nonzero, addv) combination. We need to find the 1001st such increment (when count exceeds 1000), and output the state variables at that point.

Note the counter is incremented at the top of the addv loop body, before the inner adde loop. The check happens after the adde loop completes. So we need to simulate.
